card.title: Safety Through Nonsense
card.instruction: Take control through elaborate impossible precautions, treating every objection as another reason the people present need protection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wear this ribbon before dinner. It prevents emotional lightning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Doubt attracts it. You'll need a second ribbon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My hands are covered. I can't hold a fork.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. Metal conducts resentment. I'll feed you with a wooden spoon, after we insulate your opinions.

mechanism: A uses supposed emotional lightning to impose ribbons and turns disbelief and impaired eating into reasons for more protective control.
confusable: Unlike a fixed inherited ritual, A expands impossible precautions in response to every practical objection.
comparison: The ribbon alternative shifts from clothing protection to spoon-feeding; the prophecy alternative treats reassuring sunshine as a new exposure requiring control.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
